mapper.update: UPDATE conversation SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: a.id, a.conversation_id, a.role, a.content, a.metadata, a.created_at, a.generation_status, a.reply_to_message_id, q.content AS question
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_message a JOIN conversation c ON c.id=a.conversation_id JOIN chat_message q ON q.id=a.reply_to_message_id AND q.conversation_id=a.conversation_id WHERE a.id=#{id} AND c.user_id=#{userId} AND a.generation_status IS NOT NULL

SELECT FROM chat_message a JOIN conversation c ON c.id=a.conversation_id JOIN chat_message q ON q.id=a.reply_to_message_id AND q.conversation_id=a.conversation_id WHERE a.request_key=#{requestKey} AND c.user_id=#{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_message SET content=#{content}, metadata=#{metadata}, generation_status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND generation_status='GENERATING'
UPDATE chat_message SET content='上次回答因服务重启而中断，请重新发送。', generation_status='FAILED' WHERE generation_status='GENERATING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
